climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOCG white from the Canavese, in the hills around Caluso and Ivrea. It is made from the Erbaluce grape, a native white variety grown there since ancient times. Styles include still, traditional-method sparkling and a straw wine.
